_comment: FAIL-FIRST ORACLE (Phase 30 LAY-00). Violation count dropping to zero without a game-code change means the harness is the bug — debug the wrapper/driver, never empty this fixture. Counts below are fresh greps on the generating commit (the CONTEXT estimates of 36 fillText / 23 translate were stale: feedback.js was miscounted and modal.js has zero raw fillText). Matchers are {scene, aMatch, bMatch, kind} substring rules; bMatch '' means wildcard (RNG-picked story text, seed-pinned but loose). Pairs marked tentative must be confirmed or corrected to what the build truly renders by the Plan 30-03 live sweep.
allowlistRef: tools/layout_harness/allowlist.json (starts empty; waivers live there, never here)

translate.note: 21 ctx.translate sites; boxes must be transformed via ctx.getTransform()

expectedViolations.note: SOLID (static analysis): hero HP text 'hp/maxHp' baseline hy+48 overlaps MP text 'mp/maxMp' baseline hy+54; sm=10px boxes are ~12px tall so ~6px overlap. Same column, every hero, every combat frame.

SOLID (static analysis): header title 'Combat ...' (lg=16px, baseline y=20) overlaps the encounter-story log line (sm=10px, baseline y=23); both centered at G.W/2. bMatch is wildcard: story text is RNG-picked from ENCOUNTER_STORIES (seed-pinned in the sweep, tightened after the live run).

SOLID (static analysis): Bazaar Buy rows render item.name (sm, y+26) over item.desc (xs, y+h-6=y+30) at the same x+34; ~5.6px vertical overlap whenever desc exists. Recipe scrolls always carry desc, so this pair is RNG-proof; seeded save keeps alchemyRecipes empty so scrolls are always offered.

CONFIRMED by live sweep 2026-10-09: zone-exploration title block — log line over zone name over subtitle (areas 9227/3625/4244). Zone name x subtitle is the play-report pair; log-line overlaps also recorded.

scenes.subsetNote: checked set = 20 core scenes per LAY criterion; sweep adds combatScene-1v1/combatScene-5v3, zoneExploration-encounter, bazaar-buy/bazaar-sell and modal-open variants
